content.short: Creating the infrastructure for Game & Metaverse projects to integrate Smart Contracts and NFTs.
content.description:
Blockchain gaming and Metaverse have been two hot topics in the crypto space recently. Cardano has the potential to take the lead in that sector but for that it needs a great ecosystem of tools and dApps for games to launch and grow. Including a reliable Marketplace and DEX.

What could really make the difference is in-game, in-universe integration. Imagine transacting your NFT in-game, without having to go to a marketplace. That is what we are building, an API, a launchpad for new projects to launch their own Smart Contract marketplace, to integrate NFT Trading in-game, to support in-game currency as a Cardano native asset, and much more.

We also aim to provide a unique way of updating smart contracts, controlled fully by the users. A Governance system running through the Martify token.

The idea of Martify is to decentralize NFT Trading, make it accessible everywhere you need it.
